motions.item_title: A Resolution of the Governing Board of the Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency, Designating a Survey Area and Authorizing the Preparation of a Draft Community Reinvestment Project Area Plan and Budget for the Proposed Mid-Valley Commercial Project Area
motions.motion: Board Member Burnham moved to adopt a Resolution of the Governing Board of the Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency, Designating a Survey Area and Authorizing the Preparation of a Draft Community Reinvestment Project Area Plan and Budget for the Proposed Mid-Valley Commercial Project Area. Board Member Wright seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Study of a Mid-Valley commercial project area begins
motions.summary: The agency board designated a survey area for a proposed Mid-Valley commercial project area and ordered a draft plan and budget prepared for it.
motions.impact: Nothing changes on the ground yet. This starts the study that would later come back to the agency board with a plan and a budget, and only then could tax money be steered into the area.
